convert_regnet_to_mmdet: run the CLI tool to convert a pycls pretrained RegNet model checkpoint to mmdet format
convert_stem_keys: convert stem layer keys from pycls naming (stem.conv, stem.bn) to mmdet naming (conv1, bn1)
convert_head_keys: convert head layer keys from pycls naming (head.fc) to mmdet naming (fc)
convert_reslayer_keys: convert residual layer keys from pycls naming (s1.b1.f.a) to mmdet ResNet naming (layer1.0.conv1)
run_regnet2mmdet_cli: run the regnet2mmdet script with a source model path and destination path as CLI arguments
